alternative_explanations: the original shared key/value representation is already optimal
the PairToken gain is too close to the material gate to support another micro-variant
recent induced, stateless, and recurrent pair paths show that extra pair capacity may not generalize
hypothesis.changed_mechanism: identity-initialized independent relation-value projection inside the otherwise unchanged PairToken bottleneck

hypothesis.decision_changed_if_positive: retain one 100K value-side mechanism shortlist; require a separate scale decision
